next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase must be specified if an applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is not specified"; 2023: "If the INVALID KEY phrase is not specified ... and there are no applicable exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end". 1985 refuses a WRITE with neither INVALID KEY nor a USE procedure. 2023 has no such syntax rule, accepts that WRITE and sends control to the end of the statement.
